question: Urgelling Gompa is found in the Indian state of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Urgelling Gompa** is located in Tawang, Arunachal Pradesh.
 
• It is one of the oldest monasteries in Arunachal Pradesh and is significant in the Tibetan Buddhist culture.
 
• The monastery was founded in the 15th century by Urgen Sangpo, and it is the birthplace of the 6th Dalai Lama, Tsangyang Gyatso.
 
• Urgelling Gompa is known for its serene environment and historical importance.
 
• The monastery is part of the Gelugpa sect of Tibetan Buddhism.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tawang** is also home to the famous **Tawang Monastery**, the largest monastery in India and the second-largest in the world.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is known for its diverse cultural heritage and numerous monasteries, making it an important state for Buddhist tourism in India.
 
• The state shares international borders with Bhutan, China, and Myanmar.
 
• Arunachal Pradesh is characterized by its mountainous terrain and rich biodiversity.
